name: 无障碍（设计/标准/检测）指南

map.基于WCAG 2.1标准的无障碍检测工具，包含颜色对比度计算器与合规清单评估，自: A WCAG 2.1-based accessibility checker with a color-contrast calculator and a compliance-checklist evaluation that automatically judges A/AA/AAA compliance levels.
map.示例文字 The quick brown fox: Sample text The quick brown fox
map.WCAG 2.1对比度要求：正常文字 AA≥4.5:1 / AAA≥7:1；大文: WCAG 2.1 contrast requirements: normal text AA≥4.5:1 / AAA≥7:1; large text AA≥3:1 / AAA≥4.5:1
map.对比度公式：(L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05)，L为相对亮度: Contrast formula: (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05), L is relative luminance
map.合规等级：A级（基础）→ AA级（推荐）→ AAA级（最佳），需全部满足低级要求: Compliance levels: Level A (basic) → AA (recommended) → AAA (best); you must fully meet the lower level to advance
map.颜色对比度仅是无障碍的一部分，还需关注键盘操作、屏幕阅读器兼容等: Color contrast is only part of accessibility; also pay attention to keyboard operation, screen-reader compatibility, etc.
map.📚 深度解析：无障碍（设计/标准/检测）指南: 📚 Deep Dive: Accessibility (Design / Standard / Testing) Guide
map.检测：录入前景色与背景色的 HEX，按 WCAG 相对亮度公式计算对比度，判定正: Check: enter the foreground and background HEX, compute contrast via the WCAG relative-luminance formula, and judge whether normal/large text meets AA (4.5/3.0) and AAA (7.0/4.5).
map.WCAG 2.1 清单检测：勾选 A/AA/AAA 各级别检查项（如替代文本、键: WCAG 2.1 checklist: tick A/AA/AAA items per level (e.g. alt text, keyboard reachable, focus visible) and get the compliance level and the four-principle attainment by pass rate.
map.综合无障碍评分：清单得分（权重 0.70）与对比度得分（权重 0.30）加权合成: Composite accessibility score: checklist score (weight 0.70) and contrast score (weight 0.30) combined, for version compliance review and redesign acceptance.
map.输入：前景 #1F2937、背景 #FFFFFF、正常文字 → 对比度 14.6: Input: foreground #1F2937, background #FFFFFF, normal text → contrast 14.68:1, far above the AAA 7.0:1 requirement, passes AA/AAA. Comparison: #666666 on white 5.74:1 (only passes AA), theme orange #FF6B35 on white 2.84:1 (fails, <3.0), showing dark text as body copy is safer.
map.正常文字 AA≥4.5:1、AAA≥7.0:1；大文字（≥18pt 或 14pt: Normal text AA≥4.5:1, AAA≥7.0:1; large text (≥18pt or 14pt bold) relaxes to AA≥3.0:1, AAA≥4.5:1. Below the threshold, darken the foreground or lighten the background.
map.清单和对比度哪个更关键？: Which matters more, the checklist or contrast?
map.两者都重要：对比度只解决「看得见」，清单覆盖「读屏可达、键盘操作、语义结构」等；: Both matter: contrast only solves "visible", while the checklist covers "screen-reader reachable, keyboard operable, semantic structure"; the baseline is Level A and AA is the recommended target (this tool's composite ≥75 means good accessibility).
map.无障碍检测工具，基于W3C WCAG 2.1标准，提供颜色对比度计算器（WCAG: An accessibility checker based on the W3C WCAG 2.1 standard, providing a color-contrast calculator (WCAG 1.4.3) and 14 key compliance-checklist checks, evaluated by the four principles perceivable/operable/understandable/robust, automatically judging A/AA/AAA and giving improvement suggestions.
map.14项关键WCAG合规清单（POUR四大原则）: 14 key WCAG compliance checks (POUR four principles)
map.HTML符合规范，通过W3C验证: HTML is valid and passes W3C validation
